We're atheists and we home school because communist core is both insidious and stupefying. We had our daughter in the best private schools in the state for kindergarten. All reports from her teachers showed that she was not only doing well, but in the top 85th percentile of her private school class. Then we moved out of the country and had to do homeschooling. We just adapted a free curriculum we found online for our kids. My daughter, who was at the top of her kindergarten private school class with the children of doctors, lawyers, engineers, and other professionals- she couldn't even read at the 1st grade level of the free homeschool curriculum we used. We had to do remedial training to get her up to speed with all the other homeschool children. However, after one year she's already caught up to the first grade curriculum and will be starting second grade curriculum normally next year. However, her second grade curriculum translates to a 5th grade reading level for public school students.

I cannot believe the amount of time public and private schools waste.

I'll admit that I pissed away high school drinking and smoking pot. I still passed with barely any effort. High school was a complete waste of time. I honestly would have been better dropping out at sixteen and getting into a trade.
